newsitem.title: EGYPT: Islamist students protest against Israel in Cairo.
newsitem.headline: Islamist students protest against Israel in Cairo.

text.p: Hundreds of Islamist students chanting "No to normalisation" and other anti-Israeli slogans demonstrated at Cairo University on Tuesday, eyewitnesses said.
Riot police waited in trucks outside the campus perimeter but did not intervene, they added.
One student, wrapped in a scarf to conceal his face, clambered up the inside of the gates and set fire to a composite U.S. and Israeli flag.
Some students shouted "No to the Washington visit", a reference to President Hosni Mubarak's trip to the United States, where he saw President Bill Clinton on Monday.
The students have been holding demonstrations at the university on and off since the Israeli government approved plans two weeks ago to build more houses for Jews in Arab East Jerusalem.
The police usually interevne only if students spill out of the campus on to the streets.
